name: Leon Szeli
headline: Product @ Meta | Presize (acq. by Meta) Founding CEO | IC @ CDTM Venture Fund
summary:
Entrepreneurship changed my life. You can reach me via office.leonszeli@gmail.com.

I founded Presize, a company you might recognize from 'Die Höhle der Löwen' (the German version of Shark Tank). Presize helps online shoppers find their perfect clothing size with AI. In April 2022, Presize was acquired by Meta (Facebook/Instagram), where we continued to scale our size recommendation technology to 4 billion users.

As a Product Manager (L7) at Meta, I work on one of the largest product catalogs in the world, driving xx billions in revenue across a variety of e-commerce use cases, from ads to Facebook Shops and Instagram Shopping.

I am also an active startup investor. At the CDTM Venture Fund, I serve on the board and investment committee. I also support the EWOR Team. In addition to that, I am Limited Partner in multiple venture capital funds and have made 40 angel investments.

My academic background is in Human-Computer Interaction research, with studies at LMU, Stanford, CDTM, and Cambridge. I graduated as valedictorian from TUM with a Master’s degree.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Investment Committee
positions.description:
CDTM is the birthplace of 25% of Germany’s unicorns. It’s not only one of the most selective educational institutions to get into, with a mere 6% acceptance rate, but it also boasts the highest "unicorn-to-alumni ratio" in the world (9 unicorns / 1,200 alumni). 

The CDTM Ventures Fund is Germany’s first alumni fund. We invest in the next generation of CDTM startups at the (pre)seed stage and provide support to founders through our network of 300+ LPs, all of whom are entrepreneurial operators at heart. The majority of the carry is donated to CDTM.

positions.title: Shareholder & Mentor
positions.description: I am an early investor in EWOR (the program itself). EWOR is the most selective startup program in the world (0.1% acceptance rate). Fellows are supported through a virtual-first model built on 1:1 mentorship (including 1 to 5 hours per week with one of the partners (unicorn founders)), bespoke modules, and a curated network of over 2,000 mentors, VCs, and subject matter experts.

positions.title: Product Manager (L7)
positions.description:
Joined through the acquisition of Presize and seeded the Meta Munich Office. Product Lead (IC7 - Senior Staff) for Meta's Product Catalog:
- Over 200 billion products - largest product catalog in the world
- powering over $50 billion of Meta's ads revenue
- spanning a team of 200 engineers and 50 cross-functional partners, including 16 PMs
- working on several company-wide initiatives with C-level visibility with cross-organisational partners, such as the Meta Super Intelligence Team (L10s)
- built Catalog's product intelligence layer using state of the art large language models for personalized commerce experiences
- Selected projects: Machine Learning-based Product recognition technology for Meta Ray Ban, making organic content shoppable, Conversational Commerce with Meta AI and WhatsApp Business Messaging, Instagram and Facebook's Shops, including integration of Presize's AI and computer vision technology for personalised clothing size recommendations and Gen AI based virtual Try-On for Fashion products

positions.title: Founding CEO

Presize was a VC-backed AI startup with 50 employees, >1m users, 50 B2B customers, grew from 0 to 7-digit ARR in one year after airing on German shark tank ("Die Höhle der Löwen").

Product: The most accurate body measurements from one turn in front of a smartphone and/or body shape questions. Fashion eCommerce Size recommendations people trust (higher conversion) & keep (less returns & CO2).

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Master Thesis about UX in AI. Ginmon is my industry partner (Leading Roboadvisor in Europe). Based on an algorithm, they create and rebalance a diversified investment portfolio for you. No humans needed.

My research question is: Building consumers’ trust in AI - Would you trust an algorithm with your money? It combines my passions in Tech, Innovation and Behaviourism.

Meta's mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. 

Our technologies help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology.
